subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Rajib’s habit of __sneering at the beliefs of others__ often hurts others’ sentiments.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 2' i.e. '**cynicism**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"sneering at the beliefs of others" **aligns with cynicism's aspect of mocking or looking down upon others' convictions or values.
 
• **Cynicism **(निराशावाद) - The belief that people are motivated by self-interest and distrust in their motives.
 
 
• ​**Example**: Cynicism made him doubt everyone's intentions.
 
 
 
• Using "**cynicism**" in the sentence maintains the context of the negative impact on others due to Rajib's dismissive attitude towards their beliefs.

Therefore, the correct answer is- **cynicism**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manipulation **(छल-कपट) - Influencing others in an unfair or deceitful way.

 
 
• **Example**: He used manipulation to win the argument.
 
 
 
• **Certainty **(निश्चितता) - Having no doubt or being completely confident.
 
 
• **Example**: She spoke with certainty about the solution.
 
 
 
• **Cleverness **(चतुरता) - The ability to understand and solve problems quickly and creatively.
 
 
• **Example**: His cleverness solved the puzzle fast.
